name: Igawa Haruhiro
source:
Main character. A ronin student.

He is staying with his aunt and her husband in order to attend a preparatory school.

He likes older people and is happy to live with her aunt Shion, whom he admires. As a child, he was very attached to Shion and Reina, but now he is having a little trouble grasping the distance between them.

As married women, they rekindle his feelings for them, which have become unattainable.

[From [url=http://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc077/introduction.html]official site[/url]]
